artifacts.summary: Evaluates sibling-repo, orphan-branch-commit, external-sync, and do-nothing options for recovering an ignored specs/ tree; recommends documenting the exposure and building no mechanism, since every recoverability option reintroduces the cross-branch/cross-repo churn the ignored posture exists to avoid.

memory_candidates.content: When evaluating a proposed durability/backup mechanism for an ignored specs/ tree, apply the 'does it reintroduce cross-branch/cross-repo churn' test first: sibling repositories and orphan-branch archive commits both recover bytes but add a second branch/repo that every branch-enumerating tool (CI, stale-branch sweeps, PR listings) must now learn to skip -- the same cost class the ignored posture was adopted to remove.
